messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "taken for few days or weeks"
set: ["taken for few days or weeks", "first few weeks", "short courses given as fixed-dose course for few days", "weight gain over a few days", "may only need to take for a few days for acute pain", "reassess blood pressure after a few weeks", "takes a few days to clear fully", "tell doctor about illness or infection in past few weeks", "should not be taken for more than 2 days between 20 and 30 weeks of pregnancy", "few medicines", "usually taken for life", "tell your doctor if side effects last for more than a few weeks", "tapering dose is required after more than a few days", "drowsiness may go away after a few days of treatment", "several days or longer", "up to 2 or 3 weeks for muscle spasm"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
